create_ema_for_model: create an ExponentialMovingAverage object for a PyTorch model's parameters with a given decay rate
update_ema_after_step: update the ExponentialMovingAverage shadow parameters after each optimizer step in the training loop
copy_ema_to_model: copy the ExponentialMovingAverage shadow parameters back to the original model parameters for evaluation
store_and_restore_params: store current model parameters before copying EMA weights and restore them after validation
save_and_load_ema_state: save the ExponentialMovingAverage state dict for checkpointing and load it to resume training
